cells.gaps: No named sanction or order on a controller and no published count of decisions for a stated period; commencement date not given (ETH-001 says effect on publication, ETH-006 gives none). The four directives are not yet approved.
cells.note: Proclamation 1321/2024 is in force and the Communications Authority is acting, but application is activity only (about 10 transfer approvals, a portal previewed, no decision on a named controller), so stage 4 is not met. Regulations are none, so stage 5 is also out of reach.
